messages:
sam: quick summary — ran a cross-region quantization bring-up for marlin-7B across h100/a100 in us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. compared fp16, bf16, int8 (per-channel), and fp8 (e4m3). attached perf plots + quality deltas. looking for kernel recommendations and a sizing suggestion for dedicated pools.

sam: command we used: ```scripts/bench_quant.sh --model marlin-7B --gpus h100,a100 --regions us-west-2,eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --qprofiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --evalset eval/core-1k.jsonl```

maria: nice. what eval metrics did you compute? ppl? exact-match? latency p50/p95?

sam: ppl and rouge/EM for generation tasks + a small long-context QA set to probe coherence. p50/p95 latencies and token/sec throughput per GPU recorded. charts: https://internal.redwood/test-runs/1869004321/charts (link)

kevin: raw highlights from perf runs: h100 fp16 p50=42ms p95=78ms, fp8 p50=26ms p95=52ms (~1.6x p50 speedup). a100 fp16 p50=58ms p95=110ms, fp8 p50=40ms p95=90ms (~1.45x). throughput (tokens/s) @ seq=1024 batch=8: h100 fp16=190k, fp8=310k; a100 fp16=130k, fp8=190k. note: numbers measured with KV cache disabled for cold-start paths.

lia: quality deltas: avg ppl change vs fp16: bf16 ~0.02% (negligible), fp8 +0.8% (slightly higher ppl), int8 +1.9% (noticeable on long-context QA). EM drop: int8 -2.1% on long QA, fp8 -0.4%. overall fp8 looks acceptable with calibration for our tasks.

maria: how did we calibrate fp8? static range or per-channel?

kevin: per-channel, using 2k calibration steps sampled from production prompts (truncation-aware). config snippet: ```qprofile: {type: fp8_e4m3, scheme: per_channel, calib_samples: 2000, outlier_clip: 99.5}``` worked best. int8 used symmetric per-channel with KL-minimization.

kevin: kernel notes: on h100 the custom fused-fmha+mha kernel we built for fp8 delivered the bulk of the speedup. on a100, cuBLAS+cutlass paths for fp16 still very competitive; our fp8 kernel falls back to a slower codepath unless we force the new epilogue. recommendation: use custom fp8 kernels on h100, keep bf16/fp16 on a100 unless you trade cost for a rollout.

perf-bot: automated summary: run_id=1869004321, runs=18, failures=0, data_points=3 regions x 2 gpus x 4 qprofiles. best latency: h100+fp8, best quality vs baseline: bf16 ~baseline, int8 worst on long-context.

maria: for dedicated pool sizing — do you have tokens/sec numbers multiplied by safety factor?

sam: initial rule-of-thumb we used: target steady-state 50k tokens/sec per customer route. with h100+fp8 one GPU ~310k tok/s -> 6 GPUs per customer (with 0.6 headroom). a100+fp16 one GPU ~130k -> 10 GPUs per customer. that's rough but good for capacity planning.

lia: caveat: those throughputs assume continuous batching and prefix cache warm. 95th percentile traffic spikes still need extra burst pool or fallback.

kevin: kernel fallback behavior observed in eu-west-1 for fp8 on a100: when memory pressure > 60% we hit slower OOM-safe path and throughput drops ~30%. we should set autoscale policy to prefer h100 for fp8 workloads in eu region or pin model variants.

sam: suggested rollout: canary fp8 in us-west-2 single shard -> measure 7 days -> eu canary only if no regressions in EM/ppl (>1% threshold). lia can you make a quick eval hook?

lia: yup — will add the eval-derived regression alert (em/ppl) and a per-route SLO for quality. I'll also push the fp8 calibration artifact to model-repo.

maria: one more ask: can we include a short table in the run README with p50/p95 and EM delta per GPU+qprofile so infra can auto-assign?

sam: yes. I'll produce the README and include the autoscale knobs: preferred_gpu=h100, fallback=a100, qprofile_order=[fp8,bf16,fp16,int8].

deploy-bot: deployment planned: fp8-canary-us-west-2 at 2026-03-21T02:00Z (scheduled).

kevin: ack — i'll test the kernel packaging and ensure the custom epilogue is included.

sam: thanks all — next step is a short doc and the capacity worksheet. :thumbsup:

(emoji reactions: :eyes:, :thumbsup:, :shipit:)
